title: Subsidies on Maternity Fees and Other Medical Bills for Foreigners who are Mothers or Relatives of Singapore Citizens
what_it_is: Subsidies on Maternity Fees and Other Medical Bills for Foreigners who are Mothers or Relatives of Singapore Citizens

sections.label: Subsidies for citizen spouses
sections.summary: Mothers with PR or LTVP+ married to Singapore Citizens get Citizen-level subsidies for the whole delivery episode, and appeals for foreign relatives are assessed case by case.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In particular, mothers with permanent residency or LTVP+ who are married to Singapore Citizens receive the same level of subsidies as Singapore Citizens for all items and treatments incurred for the entire delivery episode, from admission for childbirth to discharge after delivery.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: On Mr Gan’s question about help and subsidies for non-Singaporean relatives and spouses, the Ministry and our public healthcare institutions do receive appeals regarding financing for healthcare costs incurred by foreign spouses or relatives of Singapore Citizens.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We assess them on a case-by-case basis based on individual circumstances and do not specifically track the number of appeals.

sections.label: Mandatory insurance for foreigners
sections.summary: Making healthcare insurance mandatory for long-staying foreigners needs careful consideration as it may burden their Singapore Citizen family members, and feasibility will be studied.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: They may also be covered by employer medical benefits.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: However, making healthcare insurance mandatory for all long-staying foreigners will have to be carefully considered, as this may in turn pose a financial burden on their Singapore Citizen family members.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We will continue to study the feasibility of this.

sections.label: Delivery episodes by pass type
sections.summary: Based on 2024 delivery episode indications, other Pass types such as LTVP account for less than 10 percent.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, are we not able to afford to look into this?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But based on the indications that we have in respect of delivery episodes in 2024, actually, in terms of the other Pass types – LTVP and others – the numbers are really a smaller percentage; I would say less than 10%.

sections.label: Foreign spouses as PRs or LTVP+
sections.summary: Most foreign spouses seen are PRs or LTVP+ holders, so they are entitled to Singapore Citizen rates for the whole delivery episode.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As I have mentioned earlier, firstly, the majority of the foreign spouses that we see are PRs or LTVP+ holders, which means that they are entitled to Singapore Citizen rates for the whole delivery episode.

sections.label: LTVP+ healthcare benefits outside delivery
sections.summary: Outside the delivery episode, LTVP+ foreign spouses of Singapore Citizens are eligible for healthcare benefits such as in-patient subsidies at restructured hospitals, at the same level as PRs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: If it is outside the episode of delivery, LTVP+ foreign spouses of Singapore Citizens are also eligible for healthcare benefits, such as subsidies for in-patient services at the restructured hospitals and this is at the same level as PRs.

sections.label: Supporting mothers with delivery costs
sections.summary: The Ministry will continue to assess and see where it can continue supporting mothers who have difficulties with delivery costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In the meantime, we will continue to assess and to see where we can continue supporting the mothers who have difficulties with the delivery costs.
